info.title: Semaphore durable HTTP API
info.description: W1 executable boundary, not production endpoint implementation. LAN HTTP is unencrypted. Host checked for all requests; exact Origin and session-bound CSRF required for authenticated mutations. No wildcard credentialed CORS. Errors, sessions, games, history and boards are no-store. Page cursors are opaque, server validated, maximum 200 characters; reject mismatched scope. No upload or raw-clue export API.

post.description: Owner authenticated on every access; unknown and other-owner games are indistinguishable 404. Full snapshots and receipts reuse events.schema.json including its experiment-v1 envelope label; transport is durable-game-v1. Create has no retry guarantee: after a lost/uncertain response do not automatically retry; prompt the player before another creation. Commit owner and all server pins before 201. After an uncertain response, GET /api/v1/games/current may discover an active game. A 404 does not prove the prior create failed (it may have completed); require explicit player choice before creating again.

get.description: Resolve full exact cohort from accepted artifact. All eight cohort fields determine membership; no broad fallback. List all eligible scores, score descending then completed_at ascending then game_id ASCII ascending. Opaque cursor binds full cohort hash and last full tie key; altered/cross-cohort cursor is 400 invalid_cursor. Deleted account display is Deleted player. Randomized artifacts never merge.

get.description: Owner-scoped lookup of the single active game for the authenticated account. Match this static route before /games/{game_id}. Return 404 not_found when no active game exists. Resolve due work under the common game lock; a game found active may terminalize during that work and its resolved terminal envelope is returned. This is discovery only and provides no create retry guarantee. The client must not automatically retry an uncertain creation.
